name: Dandelet · Gremlet #3
description:
A dandelion lion cub with a petal mane. Its puff tail scatters seeds when it bounces.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Dandelet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
